Author: G.R.Swaminathan

 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court

 W.P.(MD)No.457 of 2024 And
 W.M.P.(MD)No.488 of 2024
 Gunasekaran ... Petition
 Vs.
 1. The Commissioner,
 Food and Safety Department,
 5th Floor, 359, Anna Salai, Chennai  6.
 2. The District Collector,
 Trichy District, Trichy.
 3. The Designated Officer,
 Food and Safety Department,
 Food Safety Wing,
 Trichy  20. ... Responden
 Prayer: Writ petition filed under Article 226 of the C
 of India, to issue a Writ of Mandamus, calling for the records pert
 to the impugned order made in Na.Ka.No.2602/F.S.D/Trichy/2023, date
 Nil, issued on 29.11.2023 passed by the 3rd respondent and to quash
 same and consequently direct the 3rd respondent to remove lock and 
 of the petitioner's grocery shop and permit the petitioner to carry
 business in the same premises. 
 For Petitioner : Mr.N.Ananda Kumar
 For R-1 to R-3 : Mr.Veerakathiravan,
 Additional Advocate General,
 assisted by,
 Mr.V.Nirmal Kumar,
 Government Advocate. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 
 1/3 

 2 W.P.(Md)No.457
 Order
The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks leave to withdraw this petition and he has also made an endorsement to that effect.
